notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Objective' and 'Starting stuff': My Lord, Is That Legal?, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Neimoidian Advisor and I Will Find Them Quickly, Master; these count toward the 60. A second Neimoidian Advisor is posted under Interrupts (2 total, as published).

The description says the deck went 11-1 'in EP1 tournaments' (Type II, Episode I-only sets); no named event or finish. Format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set Dark printings are used for Control and Alter.

Posted 'Yeb Yeb' dested Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn; 'On The Payroll Of the Trade Fed' dested On The Payroll Of The Trade Federation; 'Maul's Saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber; 'Vote Now' dested the Dark Vote Now!; 'Allegations Of Corruption' dested the Coruscant Effect (the Reflections III Defensive Shield came out after this post); Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room and Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard dested the Dark sites.
Section header lines ('Starting stuff', 'Effects and Political Effects(7)', 'Weapon and Epic Event(3)', etc.) were removed; the machine draft had parsed them as cards.
The same author posted a Light Type II list, 'Type II LS that wins from Info Broker' (DeckTech 19137), two days later.
